title: Eastern Range Weather Ops Hub
lede: Custom in-house weather tools built for Eastern Range operations, gathered in one place for testing and feedback.

categories.name: Situational awareness
categories.blurb: The big picture across the range, right now

categories.name: Forecast products
categories.blurb: Official products forecasters build and publish

categories.name: Research and training
categories.blurb: ML projects, competitions and teaching tools

tools.name: Eastern Range Weather COP
tools.description: Common operating picture of current and forecast weather across the Eastern Range.

tools.name: LLCC Probability Board
tools.description: Probability of violating each NASA-STD-4010B lightning launch commit criterion plus an overall probability, in 3-hour windows out 7 days with a custom window.

tools.name: WeatherNext Launch Board
tools.description: Long-range launch planning for LC-39A, SLC-40 and SLC-41 from Google WeatherNext 3, deterministic and full-ensemble.

tools.name: 7-Day Constraint Board (SLF page)
tools.description: Multi-model probabilities for each 7-day constraint at KTTS (crosswinds, head and tailwinds, precip within 30 nm) with CSV export into the OTV template.

tools.name: Daily Planning Forecast
tools.description: Forecaster-editable zone planning forecast for KSC, Cape Canaveral SFS and Patrick SFB, published to CSV and Excel.

tools.name: KCOF TAF Generator
tools.description: Draft 30-hour Air Force TAF for Patrick SFB in AFMAN 15-129 format, for forecasters to refine before issuing.

tools.name: Plume Constraint
tools.description: Hourly 200 ft and onshore wind constraint outlook from every model in the pipeline, including HRRR, HREF, RRFS and REFS. Limits are demo values.

tools.name: Splashdown Weather
tools.description: Splashdown constraint board for recovery sites off the Southern California coast.

tools.name: Weeks 2–6 Outlook
tools.description: Sub-seasonal temperature and precipitation outlook maps for CONUS from GEFS and ECMWF with probabilistic bias correction.

tools.name: XMR Sounding ML
tools.description: Machine-learning thunderstorm prediction trained on about 30 years of wet-season Cape Canaveral soundings.

tools.name: Thor’s Forecast Challenge
tools.description: TAF-style forecast builder for any ICAO site with obs comparison, workbook output and autograding for TFC26.
